thread:
maria: Heads-up — DeltaHealth onprem rollout status? We're at final sprint; need go/no-go checks before canary.
omar: Network team: egress NAT done, waiting on customer ACLs for 13.52.140.0/24. Sent firewall change ticket to DeltaNet (TICKET-4578).
kevin: Installer/airgap: image sync to their harbor completed; metadata checksum mismatch on worker-2, retrying now. PR #3421 fixes checksum tool.
sasha: Certs: customer uploaded intermediate chain but missing SAN for lb.deltahealth.internal. Pinged their infra to regenerate.
maria: Can you ownership-flag who owns CR approvals and the canary window? I can take rollback plan.
omar: I own the CR approvals once cert + ACL in place. Kevin pls drop PR link for review — need signoff from @sasha.
kevin: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge_requests/3421 — small change. @sasha PTAL.
sasha: Reviewing now — minor nit. If merged, we can re-run sync and verify checksums in ~15m.
infra-bot: DEPLOY-CHECK: image-sync deltahealth-harbor: pending -> 3/4 nodes verified (worker-2 failed checksum)
ops-oncall: Canary window suggestion: Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC, low production traffic. If everyone agrees I will block calendar and run smoke.
maria: Thu 02:00 works for SRE. Two outstanding blockers: customer ACLs and cert SAN. Any ETA?
omar: DeltaNet replied: ACLs scheduled for Thu 00:30 UTC. Cert ETA from DeltaHealth: Thu 01:15 UTC.
kevin: If cert done by 01:15 and PR merged by 01:30, we can run final sync and start canary at 02:00. I will stand by for merge.
sasha: Merged PR, ran quick unit. infra-bot: image-sync requeued.
infra-bot: DEPLOY-CHECK: image-sync deltahealth-harbor: started -> verifying checksums.
maria: Thanks — I'll mark owners: Network=omar, Installer=kevin, Certs=sasha, Rollback=maria. I'll send a short runbook in 30m and update the ticket.
omar: Adding one more note: need to confirm egress monitoring probe to avoid silent failures; @ops-oncall can you add a synthetic check post-canary?
ops-oncall: Yep I'll add probe and alert on >30s response or 5xx for 10m.
maria: Great. If all green we'll proceed with canary Thu 02:00 and aim full cutover by Thu 08:00. Will post final go/no-go 01:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
